name: legal-skills-all
description: Every Legal Skills workflow in one plugin: all sixty-one skills from the eleven plugins, generated from their canonical sources. Install this or the individual plugins, not both.

interface.shortDescription: Every Legal Skills plugin's skills in one install.
interface.longDescription: Bundles the skills and shared references of every Legal Skills plugin: Australian AI Governance, Australian AML/CTF, Australian Corporations Governance, Australian Employment & Fair Work, Australian Estate Planning, Australian Legal Research, Australian Litigation Deadlines, Australian Privacy & Cybersecurity, Legal Evidence Workflows, Legal Triage, Legal Workflow Router. Each skill keeps its own sources, result contract and human-review gates; the bundle adds no legal logic. It is regenerated from the individual plugins on every change, so it never drifts from them.
